E2.title: Move (Little Mix song)
E2.text: Following Little Mix's debut headlining tour, they began work on their second studio album.

E3.title: Move (Little Mix song)
E3.text: They wrote the song wanting to show off their musical progression with mature sound.

E4.title: Move (Little Mix song)
E4.text: The group achieved this by allowing the song to be more production-led than their previous material.

E6.title: Move (Little Mix song)
E6.text: "Move" is a song recorded by British girl group Little Mix.

E7.title: Move (Little Mix song)
E7.text: It was released through Syco Music, as the lead single from their second studio album, Salute (2013).

E8.title: Move (Little Mix song)
E8.text: It was co-written by members Jesy Nelson, Leigh-Anne Pinnock, Jade Thirlwall and Perrie Edwards with Maegan Cottone and Nathan Duvall, and produced by Duvall.

E9.title: Move (Little Mix song)
E9.text: "Move" garnered critical acclaim from music critics.

E10.title: Move (Little Mix song)
E10.text: The Daily Record gave the song five out of five stars, mentioning that it contains inspiration from 90s club pop as well as being R&B-infused compared to their previous singles.

E11.title: Move (Little Mix song)
E11.text: It highlighted the lyrics as being "full of attitude and the trademark Little Mix harmonies and melodies, making this song a sure hit."

E12.title: Move (Little Mix song)
E12.text: Musically Move has been described as a dance-pop and R&B song that sees the group move away from melody-led ventures, and features a more bass synth-oriented sound.

E13.title: Move (Little Mix song)
E13.text: The song received acclaim from music critics, who praised them for their approach towards new sounds compared to their previous work.

E14.title: Move (Little Mix song)
E14.text: It was named by Billboard as one of 100 Greatest Girl Group Songs of All Time.

E15.title: Move (Little Mix song)
E15.text: The official music video premiered on YouTube on 25 October 2013.

E16.title: Move (Little Mix song)
E16.text: The video starts with silhouettes of the band members appearing in front of brightly coloured backdrops.

E17.title: Move (Little Mix song)
E17.text: They are then seen in a shiny white room and Thirlwall then begins to sing the first verse.

E18.title: Move (Little Mix song)
E18.text: Throughout the video, the members are seen performing hip-hop style dances, with several dancers in the background.

E19.title: Move (Little Mix song)
E19.text: The video then moves to a large stage with bright flashing lights, where the group perform the final dance for the song.

E20.title: Move (Little Mix song)
E20.text: Attitude named the song #1 on their list of 32 greatest Little Mix singles of all time and wrote "Releasing ‘Move’ is the kind of risk we wish mainstream pop acts did more often (Cow bells?!): This R&B infused track relies less on a big catchy chorus and instead is a slinky, sexy little bop that slowly creeps up on you and once it does, becomes an unforgettable moment in pop.

E21.title: Move (Little Mix song)
E21.text: Robert Copsey of Digital Spy gave the track four out of five stars and wrote it "subtly blends the current pop trends with [Little Mix's] own inimitable style," also noting similarities with 1990s club music.

E22.title: Move (Little Mix song)
E22.text: The song peaked at number three on the UK Singles Chart, at number five on the Irish Singles Chart, and charted in eight other territories including Australia, France, and Japan.

E23.title: Move (Little Mix song)
E23.text: The group performed the song on both the Australian and American versions of The X Factor and at the Billboard studios in New York.

E24.title: Move (Little Mix song)
E24.text: It has been certified platinum in the UK and Brazil and certified gold in Australia.

E25.title: Move (Little Mix song)
E25.text: Little Mix co-wrote "Move" with Nathan Duvall and their vocal coach, Maegan Cottone.

E26.title: Move (Little Mix song)
E26.text: During a livestream, the group revealed the name of their next single and Jade Thirlwall described the songwriting process as, "We all sat in the studio together and vibed and made little noises..." Lyrically, the song talks of boys who think they are too cool to dance and ultimately leads to Little Mix telling them to move.

E27.title: Little Mix
E27.text: On 23 September 2013, "Move" was premiered on BBC Radio 1.

E28.title: Little Mix
E28.text: For the single, Little Mix worked with Nathan Duvall, an up-and-coming R&B producer and Maegan Cottone, the girl's vocal coach.

E29.title: Little Mix
E29.text: "Move" was released on 7 October in Australia and New Zealand.

E30.title: Little Mix
E30.text: It was later released in the UK and Ireland on 3 November.

E31.title: Little Mix
E31.text: It was sent to Mainstream Radio in the US on 18 February 2014 and reached number 38 on that chart.

E32.title: Little Mix
E32.text: The song peaked at number three in the UK, number five in Ireland, number 19 in Japan and number 12 in New Zealand.

E33.title: Little Mix
E33.text: The single also charted in Australia, Belgium, the Netherlands and Slovakia.

E34.title: Little Mix
E34.text: Since then, "Move" has been certified gold in Australia for sales of 35,000 and gold in the UK for sales of 400,000.

E35.title: Little Mix
E35.text: "Little Me" was selected as the second single from the album.

E36.title: Little Mix
E36.text: The song was co-written by TMS and Iain James and produced by TMS.
